description: pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs:1014-1018 in build_first_valid_path_with_config: when the PathCandidates iterator yields Some(Err(BudgetExceeded)) AFTER some candidates have been tried and rejected, the function returns Err(BudgetExceeded) verbatim, dropping the accumulated `tried` counter and the `last_error` String. The rustdoc explicitly endorses this ("We do NOT wrap these in NoValidPath because they describe failures of the topological search") and the reasoning is internally consistent. Operational consequence: a user debugging a builder that tried 47 candidates and ran out of budget gets exactly the same error report as a user whose first frame ran out of budget. Diagnostics for adversarial pools, performance investigations, and post-mortems all degrade. Possible fix: add a new variant Error::BudgetExceededAfterCandidates { tried: usize, last_error: String } or extend BudgetExceeded with these fields (breaking, but Error is #[non_exhaustive]). At minimum, this tradeoff deserves to be called out in build_first_valid_path's rustdoc as a known-debug-limitation so future debugging sessions don't waste time looking for the missing diagnostic state.
title: BudgetExceeded mid-iteration loses partial diagnostic state (tried count + last_error)
